title: About Crossroads
content: Crossroads Conservatory of Music is a community music school at 1420 Grand Blvd, Kansas City, MO, in the Crossroads Arts District. Founded in 2021 by jazz saxophonist Jessica Webb, we offer private lessons, group theory, and ensembles for students of every age and level. Our faculty are working Kansas City musicians who teach the way they play.

title: Contact
content: Reach Crossroads at info@crossroadsconservatory.com or call (816) 221-7700. Visit us at 1420 Grand Blvd, Kansas City, MO 64108. Note: our web contact form is temporarily unavailable — please email or call directly.

title: Classes & Lessons
content: Crossroads offers private lessons on saxophone, piano, bass, drums, and voice, plus group theory and student ensembles. New students begin with a placement lesson. Spring enrollment is open now. Visit crossroadsconservatory.com to register.

title: Anniversary Showcase
content: The Crossroads 5th Anniversary Showcase is our biggest event of the year: October 10, 2026, at 6pm at The Phoenix. Students from every track perform, with a closing faculty set. Seating is limited; reservation details will be posted on the news page.

title: Privacy Policy
content: Crossroads Conservatory uses student and family contact information only for lesson scheduling, enrollment communication, and our newsletter. We do not share personal data with third parties.
